newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli troops kill Palestinian in Hebron clash.
newsitem.headline: Israeli troops kill Palestinian in Hebron clash.

text.p: Israeli soldiers shot dead a Palestinian youth during heavy clashes with stone-throwers in the West Bank town of Hebron on Tuesday, hospital officials said.

A Jewish settler earlier shot dead a Palestinian in the West Bank town, sparking fierce clashes. Officials at al-Ahli hospital said an 18-year-old shot by soldiers died from a rubber-coated metal bullet that penetrated his brain.
Hospitals said a total of 77 Palestinians were wounded by rubber bullets or rubber-coated metal bullets.
They said one of the wounded was in critical condition and had been taken to an Israeli hospital in Jerusalem for treatment.
